fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a key material property that affects the weight and application of the mortar, plaster, or screed product.

fields.name: layer_thickness
fields.rationale: Layer thickness is important for application guidelines and performance characteristics of the product.

fields.name: application_method
fields.rationale: The method of application (manual or machine) affects the labor and equipment needed for installation.
evidence: "Mix the bonding and reinforcing mortar and base coat manually or by machine"
inference_basis: Mention of manual and machine mixing suggests these are the primary application methods.

fields.name: suitable_substrates
fields.rationale: Identifying suitable substrates helps in determining the compatibility of the product with different surfaces.
evidence: "suitable for application on existing mineral renders and almost all existing organic renders and masonries"
inference_basis: Mention of mineral and organic renders and masonry indicates these are suitable substrates.

fields.name: reinforcement_compatibility
fields.rationale: Compatibility with reinforcement materials like mesh is crucial for structural applications.
evidence: "fully embed the system mesh (Sto-Glass Fibre Mesh) in the middle or upper half of the fresh mortar coat"
inference_basis: Mention of embedding mesh suggests compatibility with reinforcement materials.
